findings.excerpt: In January 2026 we announced that Miromatrix completed a phase 1 study of miroliverELAP in patients with acute liver failure. This study, which was the first human clinical trial of a manufactured organ alternative, met its primary endpoint. Miromatrix is planning to commence a phase 2 study.
